sourceSelector.emptyDescription: If you just granted screen recording permission, reload this picker. On macOS you may need to reopen OpenScreen.
sourceSelector.loadFailedDescription: OpenScreen could not load capture sources. Reload this picker and try again.

recording.selectSource: Please select a source to record
recording.systemPicker: Your system will ask what to share

systemLanguagePrompt.title: Use your system language?
systemLanguagePrompt.description: We detected {{language}} as your system language. Do you want to switch OpenScreen to {{language}}?

softwareEncoderFallback.title: Switched to software encoding
softwareEncoderFallback.description: The default GPU encoder failed to start, so OpenScreen fell back to software H.264 encoding. Recording should continue as normal, but CPU usage may be higher.

permissions.title: OpenScreen needs a few permissions
permissions.subtitle: macOS asks you to grant each one once. You can change them at any time in System Settings.

screen.name: Screen & system audio
screen.description: To record your screen and the sound your Mac plays.

accessibility.name: Accessibility
accessibility.description: To show the right cursor (pointer, text) in your recordings.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: To add your webcam to your recordings.

help.screenPrompt: macOS will then ask you to turn on OpenScreen in System Settings.
help.screenSettings: In System Settings, turn on OpenScreen. If macOS offers to quit and reopen it, accept: this window will come back.
help.screenNotListed: OpenScreen isn't in the list? Click +, then choose OpenScreen in Applications.
help.screenRestart: Allowed. OpenScreen needs to restart before it can use it.
help.screenRecurring: macOS will occasionally ask you to confirm this access. That's expected.

footer.screenRequired: Screen recording is needed to record.
